questions.q: What are sakinah, mawaddah and rahmah?
options: Tranquillity, deep love and compassion as the foundation of the home
questions.explain: Khadijah was a source of tranquillity for the Prophet SAW.

questions.q: How was Khadijah's burial carried out given the situation at the time?
options: The Prophet SAW lowered the body into the grave; funeral prayer did not yet exist
questions.explain: There was not yet a funeral prayer or washing of the dead then.

questions.q: What did the Prophet SAW recognise on seeing the ransom of Abul As?
questions.explain: The companions freed Abul As with that necklace.

questions.q: Why must words of comfort be chosen carefully?
options: Words like "Allah will replace it with better" may hurt the bereaved

questions.q: What is said about the Prophet's SAW faithfulness to Khadijah?
options: Though polygamy was common, he took no other wife during her lifetime
questions.explain: Faithful to one's spouse throughout life.

questions.q: The grief of the bereaved weighs heavier after people return to their routines.
questions.explain: True. Grief lasts longer than the first day.

questions.q: One bad moment or an unkind last word decides the whole journey of a life.
questions.explain: False. One bad moment does not define the whole journey.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: The Prophet SAW stays at Hujun
Khadijah's necklace becomes Abul As's ransom
The Prophet SAW lowers her body into the grave

questions.explain: Khadijah died, was buried, he withdrew, the necklace became a ransom, and he returned as a conqueror.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The year of the deaths of Abu Talib and Khadijah
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un
Where Khadijah is buried in Al-Mu'alla

questions.explain: Condolence is words of sympathy, istirja' is Inna lillahi, Al-Hajun is where Khadijah is buried, and Aam al-Huzn is the Year of Sorrow.

questions.q: How can we cheer up the sorrowful according to this lecture?
options: Understanding their sorrow and being present
questions.explain: Reading these stories helps us understand others' sorrow.
